notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware or sim backend was run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: none in helper or decision; the package uses GymnasiumDriver with native dronesim.envs.CtrlAviary:CtrlAviary. The card's mock_strategy preferred upstream-sim was not used because pybullet and legacy gym are not installed where the gate runs and package code never imports the clone; fake.py is a pure-Python F0 kinematic stand-in for the default one-tello CtrlAviary. The fake publishes the single tello's four PWM commands as one Box(4) rather than upstream's Dict keyed by the numeric drone index: the bridge derives limit paths from action-space keys and its field-name grammar rejects 'action.0'; for one drone the four commands are identical, and the fake's step also accepts the upstream Dict form. NOT COVERED: multi-drone worlds, other drone models, initial_xyzs/vels/rpys, contacts/aerodynamics/sensors, a sim backend (the upstream registers no gym id, so env_id is unset), and any comparison of the fake with the upstream environment. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the family's seed only sets the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for inputs the bridge derives (seed twice, ticks, action.values). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No catalogue requests; only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, all R0. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
